svg.title: Heat map: day x documentary family, automated provider-origin AI roles
svg.desc: A grid of 12 documentary families by 30 UTC days, shaded by the number of automated provider-origin AI GET 200 requests.
svg.text: Heat map: day x documentary family,
fetches are left out of this daily view by the
Unit: requests per UTC day and family. Built from
the joint aggregate, never from marginals.
Every day of the window has rows; no cell is unknown.
Families are those of the scope registry; the right-hand
number is the family total for the window. Compact view:
